headline: From 700 USD to 4,970 USD per Person, Vietnam Is a Development Miracle for the World
summary: Vietnam has entered the group of upper-middle-income countries after per capita gross national income reached 4,970 USD in 2025. The article cites analysis from a Ho Chi Minh City university lecturer.
why: Income classifications by the World Bank influence investor perceptions of growth, consumer demand and credit risk in emerging markets. Gross national income per capita is the standard measure used.
